display.purpose: The landing headline and the closing invitation. One per page at most.

headline.purpose: Page titles and the opening line of a section.

body.purpose: All running text. Measure capped at 68ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked field labels, step names and meta lines.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Elements that genuinely leave the page plane. Offset plus soft blur, never a zero offset halo.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: The left edge of the cart drawer only.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: The house curve. Fast departure, long settle. Every entrance and every scroll linked fade.

motion.name: ease-out-quiet
motion.purpose: Small controls: chips, buttons, field grounds.

motion.name: ease-in-out-soft
motion.purpose: Things that leave the way they arrived.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Cross fades, filter swaps, gallery changes.

motion.name: duration-marquee
motion.purpose: One pass of the reviews marquee, roughly 35px per second. Pauses on hover and focus.

motion.name: spring-settle
motion.purpose: Cart drawer travel. Critically damped, never overshoots.

motion.name: spring-drape
motion.purpose: Large surfaces that need a slower settle.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one call to action on a surface. Charcoal ground, cream text, press scales.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 1.75rem; background: var(--color-ink, #2b2523); color: var(--color-cream, #fbf8f4); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3b3431; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blush-deep, #9a5346); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The quieter partner action. Shell ground that warms to blush on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 1.75rem; background: var(--color-shell, #ede3d9); color: var(--color-ink, #2b2523); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-blush-soft, #ecd5cf); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blush-deep, #9a5346); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Category filters on the shop and portfolio. The selected chip inverts.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-chip { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-sand, #f3ece4); color: var(--color-ink-soft, #6b5f58); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--color-shell, #ede3d9); color: var(--color-ink, #2b2523); } .ds-chip-selected, .ds-chip-selected:hover { background: var(--color-ink, #2b2523); color: var(--color-cream, #fbf8f4); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blush-deep, #9a5346); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Sand ground, no stroke, uppercase tracked label above it.
components.html: Nowa confirms the date here.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.8125rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #6b5f58); } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: var(--color-sand, #f3ece4); color: var(--color-ink, #2b2523); border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1rem; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1); } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: rgb(107 95 88 / 0.75); } .ds-field-input:hover, .ds-field-input:focus { background: var(--color-shell, #ede3d9); } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blush-deep, #9a5346); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field-hint { margin: 0; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #6b5f58); }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: One 72px line. Serif wordmark, sans links, cart count last.
components.html:
Nowa's Cakes
ShopPortfolioAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; height: 72px; padding: 0 2.5rem; background: rgb(251 248 244 / 0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); } .ds-nav-mark { font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-ink, #2b2523); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2rem; margin-left: auto; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #6b5f58); text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link-active { color: var(--color-ink, #2b2523); } .ds-nav-cart { background: none; border: none; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #6b5f58); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1); } .ds-nav-cart:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #2b2523); }

components.name: Image Plate
components.description: Every picture in the system. One radius, sand underneath, label below and never over it.
components.css: .ds-plate { margin: 0; width: 260px; } .ds-plate-img { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; border-radius: 14px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #f3ece4, #d6a9a0); transition: transform 620ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-plate:hover .ds-plate-img { transform: scale(1.018); } .ds-plate-caption { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 1rem; margin-top: 1rem; } .ds-plate-title { font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--color-ink, #2b2523); } .ds-plate-meta { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #6b5f58); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Sequence Caption
components.description: The step label that fades in and out with its frame range over the baking sequence.
components.html:
Frosting

Buttercream goes on warm and is pulled back with a palette knife until the sides go still.
components.css: .ds-caption { max-width: 42ch; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(251 248 244 / 0.88); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; } .ds-caption-step { margin: 0; font-size: 0.8125rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--color-blush-deep, #9a5346); } .ds-caption-body { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--color-ink, #2b2523); }

narrative.overview: The system is a room with one window. Everything sits on a warm off-white ground the colour of unbleached paper, and the only things allowed to be loud are the photographs. There is no chrome competing with the food: no borders around content, no shadows under cards, no coloured panels calling for attention. What carries the design instead is the amount of air between things and the difference between a 62px Bodoni headline and a 13px tracked label. The interface is built to recede. Type sits in two registers only, a high contrast Didone for anything that speaks and a quiet humanist grotesque for anything that explains. Images are always plates: a single soft radius, cropped, with their label underneath rather than over them. Colour is almost absent, held back so that one muted blush can mean something when it appears on a rating, a step label or a selected control. The page's one piece of theatre is motion, and it is scroll driven rather than decorative: a cake that grows until it owns the viewport, then dissolves into the eight steps that made it. Nothing bounces, nothing overshoots, nothing moves that the reader did not move themselves.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white ground, never white, never grey
One muted blush accent, deepened when it must carry text
High contrast serif display over a quiet grotesque body
One radius system, borrowed by every plate, control and panel
No borders on content and effectively no shadows
Asymmetric, unequal grids; whitespace is the layout

rules.name: The No Grey Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is tinted from the ground's own hue (#6b5f58), never a neutral grey. A grey on this cream reads as a rendering fault.

rules.name: The Accent Ceiling Rule
rules.body: The blush family touches at most a few percent of any screen. If two blush elements are visible at once, one of them is decoration and should be removed.

rules.name: The Deepen Before You Type Rule
rules.body: #d6a9a0 is a surface value. The moment the accent has to carry a glyph or a word, it becomes #9a5346.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif speaks, sans explains. A serif never labels a control and a sans never carries a page's main statement.

rules.name: The Two Line Headline Rule
rules.body: The landing headline is allowed two lines at every breakpoint. If a copy change pushes it to three, the copy is wrong, not the type scale.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every price, quantity and count carries font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, so numbers do not shuffle when they change.

rules.name: The One Elevation Rule
rules.body: A surface declares depth with a tone change or a shadow, never both. There are no bordered cards in this system, and no card sits inside another card.

dos: Do put every label under its image. A picture in this system is never printed on.
Do deepen the accent to #9a5346 before setting any word in it.
Do keep scroll position in useScroll and useTransform only, and map opacity through a function rather than a keyframe range so Motion does not promote it to its own scroll timeline.
Do size sticky sections in svh.
Do give every image plate a sand ground underneath it.
Do animate transform and opacity only, on the exponential ease out cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
donts: Don't use an em dash or an en dash anywhere, including JSON data and alt text.
Don't add a scroll cue, a down arrow, a badge over an image, or a row of three equal cards.
Don't put a border and a shadow on the same surface, or a card inside a card.
Don't reach for grey. Secondary text is #6b5f58.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing, or a spring that overshoots.
Don't listen to the scroll event directly, and never set React state once per animation frame.
Don't introduce a dark theme. The page theme is locked to light.
